senses.gloss: f. (אוֹף m.) (b. h. face, looks, whence, nature, disposition, ways &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:6">Y. Shek. I, 45ᵈ</cite> <he>אין אתה יכול לעמוד על א׳ של וכ׳</he> You cannot understand the nature of that people.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>אופוֹ של דוד</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. pr. <he>אופי</he>, ed. <cite ref="A02606"><he>אפו</he></cite>) David’s ways. Y’lamd. Vaëthḥ. (quot. in Ar.) ‘who is that nation’ <he>שהיא יודעת אופו של אלוהיה</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (oth. ed. <he>אופי</he>) that knows the ways of her God (what he desires &c.); v.
Gen. R. s. 14 end נשמה זו הא׳ n’shamah (breath, soul) means the disposition, character, as people say האוֹפִיתָא טבא the good nature!
